note: Crawler names change. Each row carries the date its source was last checked. Check the sources again before each release; robots_check.py prints the oldest date it used.

purposes.search: Feeds an assistant's or search engine's answers and links. Blocking it keeps your pages out of those answers.
purposes.user: Fetches a page when a person asks the assistant to look at it. Some of these do not follow robots.txt at all.
purposes.training: Collects pages that may be used to train AI models. Blocking it is an opt-out from training and does not keep you out of search answers.

agents.if_blocked: Your pages will not be shown in ChatGPT search answers.

agents.product: Pages a ChatGPT user asks it to open
agents.if_blocked: OpenAI says robots.txt rules may not apply to these user-initiated visits.
Your content should not be used to train OpenAI's models. It does not affect ChatGPT search answers.
Anthropic says your content will not be indexed for its search, which may reduce how visible and accurate you are in Claude's answers.

agents.product: Pages a Claude user's question leads it to open
agents.if_blocked: Claude cannot retrieve your pages in answer to a user's question.
Your future pages should be left out of Anthropic's training data. It does not affect Claude's search.
Perplexity recommends allowing it so your pages can be surfaced and linked in its answers.

agents.product: Pages a Perplexity user's question leads it to open
agents.if_blocked: Perplexity says this fetcher generally ignores robots.txt, because a person asked for the page.

agents.product: Google Search, which Google's AI answers draw on
agents.if_blocked: Your pages drop out of Google Search, and with it Google's AI answers.
Google says it does not affect your inclusion or ranking in Google Search. It controls use of your pages for Gemini models.

agents.product: Bing Search, which Microsoft Copilot answers draw on
agents.if_blocked: Your pages drop out of Bing, and with it the answers built from Bing.

agents.product: Apple search features such as Siri and Spotlight suggestions
agents.if_blocked: Your pages may not appear in Apple's search features.
An opt-out from Apple model training; it does not remove you from Apple search features.

agents.product: A public web archive many AI models are trained on
agents.if_blocked: An opt-out from future Common Crawl archives; it does not affect search answers.
